# llms.txt — Machine-readable documentation index
# Format: <path> — <purpose>
# This file helps AI agents discover project documentation.

# Root-level docs
README.md — Project overview, quickstart, architecture diagram
AGENTS.md — AI coding assistant instructions and conventions
CLAUDE.md — Claude Code entry point (points to AGENTS.md)
CONVENTIONS.md — Coding standards, naming, testing rules

# Project scope
docs/project-scope.md — Full project description, data sources, capabilities, industry use cases

# Architecture docs
docs/architecture.md — Full system architecture, component diagrams, data flow
docs/agents.md — Agent specifications (inputs, outputs, tools, boundaries)
docs/knowledge-graph.md — Neo4j schema, entity types, relationship types, Cypher queries
docs/pipeline.md — End-to-end data flow (ingestion → extraction → graph → retrieval → query)
docs/models.md — Groq model selection, rate limits, when to use each model
docs/setup.md — Installation, Docker setup, environment variables, first-run verification

# Operational docs
docs/troubleshooting.md — Error → cause → fix resolution table
docs/runbooks/ingestion.md — How to add new data sources
docs/runbooks/graph-update.md — How to update the knowledge graph incrementally

# Decision records
